identity.title: List of Pokémon Adventures monthly issues

leadText:
This is a list of monthly issues of the Pokémon Adventures . These monthly A4 size comic books were released by VIZ Media before the release of the collected volumes, as this format was more popular for American or Japanese comics in the early 2000s, before readers began to prefer collected volumes or monthly manga magazines.

While the English versions of these manga books have been translated into other languages worldwide, they are not available in Japan or .
